capabilities: Push notes or whole folders to Notion as formatted pages
Pull Notion edits back into Obsidian as Markdown
Sync notes with timestamp-based conflict detection and a Keep local / Keep Notion choice
Convert wiki-links into Notion page mentions and upload deeply nested blocks
Connect to Notion via API token or one-click OAuth
extras: Free and open source under GPL v3.0; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; installable via BRAT; credentials are stored in plugin settings, not an OS credential vault.
intentEvidence: Notional is a maintained fork of the original Nobsidion work by Quan Phan
motivation: The author built it to end the manual copy-paste routine of moving notes to Notion while keeping links, structure, and both sides in sync without silent overwrites.
problem: Sharing Obsidian notes in Notion means copy-pasting that breaks wiki-links, flattens nested outlines, and leaves stale duplicates with no way to tell which copy is current.

relations.evidence: Notional is a maintained fork of the original Nobsidion work by Quan Phan
which itself traces back to Obsidian to Notion by EasyChris
Two-way sync for your Markdown notes and Notion

requires.name: Notion API token (or OAuth client credentials)

summary: Two-way Obsidian-Notion sync that pushes notes and folders to Notion, pulls edits back, and converts wiki-links into Notion page mentions.
